Package simple.crypto

Class AES

java.lang.Object
simple.crypto.AES
All Implemented Interfaces:
CryptoEngine, RawCryptoEngine
public final class AES extends Object implements CryptoEngine
AES (Advanced Encryption Standard) cryptographic engine implementing CryptoEngine.

This class provides methods to perform encryption and decryption using the AES symmetric encryption algorithm. It supports encryption and decryption of various types of objects, both as raw byte arrays and as JSON representations.

AES encryption uses a 256-bit key size by default and stores the key in a keystore file for secure management.
